definitions.explanation: A book published as a single, independent volume rather than as part of a series, magazine, or periodical. In manga culture, refers to the collected volumes that compile chapters originally serialized in magazines.

examples.japanese: {単行本|たんこうぼん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単行本|たんこうぼん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧20{巻|かん}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This manga has 20 collected volumes in total.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}ま→読む：00426_yomu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{単行本|たんこうぼん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単行本|たんこうぼん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (buy a collected volume)
- {単行本|たんこうぼん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (a volume comes out)
- {単行本|たんこうぼん}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (being compiled into a volume)

USAGE:
In everyday conversation, {単行本|たんこうぼん} most often refers to manga volumes — the tankoubon format that collects several magazine chapters into one book. In publishing more broadly, it refers to any book published as a standalone volume, as opposed to a ⟦{文庫本|ぶんこぼん}→文庫本：12915_bunkobon⟧ (paperback) or ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧ (magazine). Often abbreviated informally as タンコ.
